scope: Stable private source contract for independent audit; no new public product API
Record_binding: EditorLease editorCallbackLease; Replacement replacementCallback; InputFilter editorFilter; existing mutation/changing scopes retained
replacement: Separate field-owned Replacement; ordinary EditorLease equality unchanged; exact own Eold predecessor only during CLOSING
scalar_new_entry_guard: editorDispatchAvailable(record) excludes all new renderer-wide editor entries during any replacement reservation before native live getters, without authority or automatic retirement
continuation_mutation: Every editor/replacement bound Mutation.current/require/result validates its captured exact scope on every use; replacement cannot authorize bind/layout
last_clear: Exact replacementBegin/End; completed suffix only, no synchronous owner/coordinator resumption; failed invariant retains busy guard
